stemBlocks: A crate has a total mass of $800 \text{ kg}$, including its contents. A helicopter of mass $4200 \text{ kg}$ is carrying the crate using a light inextensible rope as shown: The helicopter and crate are accelerating upwards at $2.0 \text{ ms}^{-2}$.
What is the tension in the rope? (The gravitational field strength $g$ is $10 \text{ Nkg}^{-1}$; air resistance can be ignored.)
